summary: Build ISO 19011 audit programme, preparation, evidence, and follow-up skills in PECB Certified Management Systems Internal Auditor training.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who maintain management systems or plan, conduct, and follow up on internal audits.
modules: Conduct, Close, and Follow Up Audits
prerequisites: To attend, you need basic knowledge of the common structure and requirements of management system standards.
